# TSBS DevOps — Double GroupBy - 1 Hour

```{tags} reference, query-template, tsbs_devops
```

> [TSBS DevOps](../../tsbs-devops.md) benchmark · [all TSBS DevOps queries](index.md)

CPU aggregations grouped by hostname and time bucket

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
SELECT
    hostname,
    DATE_TRUNC('minute', time) as minute,
    AVG(usage_user) as avg_user,
    MAX(usage_user) as max_user
FROM cpu
WHERE time >= '2024-01-02 03:00:00'
  AND time < '2024-01-02 04:00:00'
GROUP BY hostname, DATE_TRUNC('minute', time)
ORDER BY hostname, minute
```
